name: Post Surgery Pillow (PSP)
tagline: A sensor pillow that monitors patients' vitals and ranks who needs a nurse first, with AI-written interventions.
problem: Nurses juggle several critically ill patients and must decide quickly who needs help.
solution: Pillow sensors track temperature, pressure, movement, heart rate and oxygen; a weighted score with edge-case overrides ranks patients by risk; Gemini writes a clinical summary with suggested nursing actions.
demo_moment: Team-described: a simulated patient with one critical vital jumps to the top of the list with a suggested response.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “1st Best Overall Hack” among 160 submissions.
An override catches one critical vital that an average would hide.
A physical object plus a ranked list gives judges an instant read.

lessons: Show the edge case your scoring catches; it proves the logic matters.
